export_jobs_date_range_check.name: export_jobs_date_range_check
export_jobs_date_range_check.value: "export_jobs"."date_from" is null or "export_jobs"."date_to" is null or "export_jobs"."date_to" >= "export_jobs"."date_from"

recurring_candidates_expected_amount_cur.name: recurring_candidates_expected_amount_currency_check
recurring_candidates_expected_amount_cur.value: "recurring_candidates"."expected_amount_minor" is null or "recurring_candidates"."expected_currency_code" is not null

tag_reminders_threshold_required_check.name: tag_reminders_threshold_required_check
tag_reminders_threshold_required_check.value: "tag_reminders"."kind" <> 'amount_threshold' or ("tag_reminders"."threshold_minor" is not null and "tag_reminders"."currency_code" is not null)

transaction_templates_amount_currency_pa.name: transaction_templates_amount_currency_pair_check
transaction_templates_amount_currency_pa.value: "transaction_templates"."amount_minor" is null or "transaction_templates"."currency_code" is not null

transactions_transfer_id_check.name: transactions_transfer_id_check
transactions_transfer_id_check.value: ("transactions"."transfer_kind" = 'none' and "transactions"."transfer_id" is null) or ("transactions"."transfer_kind" = 'internal' and "transactions"."transfer_id" is not null) or "transactions"."transfer_kind" in ('external_out', 'external_in')
